"40% lower per-token cost in our new inference benchmark. Live demo Thu 11AM PT. Register: https://redwood.ai/webinar #inference"

Liam (Social): Adding boost rule to the campaign. I'll schedule and share Buffer links once set. Devon (Demand): Drafting two reply templates now: 1) Quick qualification + calendar ask, 2) Technical follow-up asking about model/sequence length. Dropping them in 30m. BoostBot: Paid campaign scheduled: LinkedIn boost window ready. Maya (Mktg): Great work team. If anything changes on assets ping me. Quick ask: Sam, can you export an IG square for cross-post? Sam (Creative): Yep exporting now. Done in 5. :rocket:
